minutes_text:
CITY COUNCIL
MINUTES
CITY OF BALDWIN PARK
CITY COUNCIL
WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 19, 2009
7:00 p.m. COUNCIL CHAMBERS
14403 E. Pacific Avenue
Baldwin Park
Manuel Lozano, Mayor
Marlen Garcia, Mayor Pro Tem Monica Garcia, Ricardo Pacheco, Susan Rubio, Council Members
Maria Contreras, City Treasurer Alejandra Avila, City Clerk
The CITY COUNCIL of the City of Baldwin Park met in REGULAR SESSION at the above time and place.
CALL TO ORDER
INVOCATION
Led by Council member Bejarano
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
Present: Council member Bejarano, Council member Marlen Garcia, Council member Pacheco, Mayor Pro Tem Monica Garcia, Mayor Lozano.
Absent: None.
Also Present: Chief Executive Officer Vijay Singhal, City Attorney Joseph W. Pannone, Director of Recreation & Community Services Manuel Carrillo Jr., Chief of Police Lili Hadsell, Director of Finance Lorena Quijano, City Treasurer Contreras, City Clerk Rubio.
ANNOUNCEMENTS
PROCLAMATIONS, COMMENDATIONS & PRESENTATIONS
Introduction and Administration of Oaths of Office to new Baldwin Park Police Officers & Dispatchers
Chief Hadsell introduced new members of the police department and provided a brief bio on each
Each Council member welcomed the newly appointed officers and dispatchers to the City of Baldwin Park. Mayor Lozano spoke about the progress that he has seen during his thirty years in Baldwin Park and that the Council had worked to clean up the city. He congratulated the veteran officers for being part of the progress and welcomed the newly appointed members of the Police Department
Mayor Lozano acknowledged the families of the officers and dispatchers in attendance and thanked them for being present
PUBLIC COMMUNICATIONS
Thomas Cary , resident addressed comments previously made by Council member Bejarano regarding the police department; increased gang activity in his area and other issues he would like to see corrected
Susan Reyes, representative for Assemblymember Ed Hernandez congratulated the Chief for the selection of new police department staff members and announced the the 2nd Annual Tools for School Drive
Edgar Ontiveros, Covina resident/member of the Tobacco Free coalition thanked the Council for considering the tobacco retail licensing fees
Xavier Gonzales, resident appealed the denial of his business license. He moved his business from one location to another and the type of business that he conducted was not a permitted use in the new location. He further spoke about the hardship that this had caused him.
Hugo Antonio Tzec , resident and candidate for school board addressed education and some things that he was not happy with such as test scores and Program Improvement. He spoke about his desire to reform education and improve test scores for the district and to meet with the Council to discuss education issues
Laura Becker, student researcher from San Diego introduced herself and announced that she was conducting an undergraduate thesis on cities in the San Gabriel Valley
Fidel Vargas, resident spoke about the recent awards that the city had won including "All American City" in which Baldwin Park placed 9th nationally and the favorable comments about the city in the Chinese Daily News
Ceci Lee, business owner acknowledged City Clerk Susan Rubio and City Treasurer Contreras for the work they have done with the Sister City Association
CONSENT CALENDAR
Motion: Approve CONSENT CALENDAR
Moved by Mayor Lozano, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Monica Garcia.
1. WARRANTS AND DEMANDS
Staff Report
City Council received and filed.
2. PROPOSED RECOGNITIONS BY THE MAYOR AND CITY COUNCIL FOR THE PERIOD OF AUGUST 19, 2009 THROUGH SEPTEMBER 1, 2009
Staff Report
City Council approved the preparation and presentation of the plaques and certificates as outlined in the staff report.
3. MINUTES
Staff Report
City Council approved the minutes of the special meeting of August 5, 2009.
4. NEW BUSINESS LICENSE FEE FOR TOBACCO RETAILERS
Staff Report
City Council adopted Resolution No. 2009-001 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK AMENDING THE FEE SCHEDULE, ADOPTED BY RESOLUTION NO. 2009-001, TO ESTABLISH FEES FOR THE ADMINISTRATION, MONITORING AND ENFORCEMENT OF THE TOBACCO RETAIL LICENSING ORDINANCE NO. 1321."
5. RESOLUTION NO. 2009-037 IN SUPPORT OF THE COUNTY PROVIDING SAFETY BOOTS TO OFFICERS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF ANIMAL CARE AND CONTROL
Staff Report
City Council adopted Resolution No. 2009-037 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK EXPRESSING ITS SUPPORT FOR THE COUNTY TO PROVIDE SAFETY BOOTS TO THE OFFICERS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF ANIMAL CARE AND CONTROL."
6. AWARD A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES CONTRACT FOR PROGRAM MANAGEMENT OF THE TRANSIT CENTER PARKING STRUCTURE TO AAE, INC. IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $168,320
Staff Report
City Council approved a Professional Services Agreement with AAE, Inc. for Program Management of Transit Center Parking Structure in an amount not to exceed $168,320 and authorized the Mayor to execute the Agreement.
7. RESOLUTION NO. 2009-004 IN SUPPORT OF A CALIFORNIA CONSTITUTIONAL CONVENTION
Staff Report
City Council adopted Resolution No. 2009-037 entitled, "A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF BALDWIN PARK SUPPORTING A CALIFORNIA CONSTITUTIONAL CONVENTION."
8. AUTHORIZATION TO PREPARE A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL FOR SOLID WASTE AND RECYCLING SERVICES
Staff Report
City Council authorized staff to prepare for Council approval and publishing a Request for Proposals for Solid Waste Services to coincide with the expiration in June 2010 of the current contract.
CITY COUNCIL/ CITY CLERK / CITY TREASURER / STAFF REQUESTS & COMMUNICATIONS
Request by Mayor Pro Tem Monica Garcia for discussion on the following:
1) Consideration of resolution to condemn violence against women in Ciudad Juarez and to express support for the families of recently abducted teenage women; and
Mayor Pro Tem Monica Garcia shared a recent article that she had read regarding the violence taking place against women in Ciudad Juarez and requested that the Council consider adopting a resolution condemning these acts
2) Consideration of hosting of a Women’s Forum in Baldwin Park to generate awareness about violence against women and identify programs and resources to proactively manage these challenges
Mayor Pro Tem Monica Garcia suggested having a forum where women could meet and speak against violence and expressed her hope that the Chief of Police and other females in the community could participate. It was further suggested that this type of event take place in October which is Domestic Violence Awareness Month
Council member Pacheco pointed out that former Congresswoman Hilda Solis brought forward a resolution against the violence in Juarez. He further expressed that this was an issue of importance in the community
ADJOURNMENT
There being no other matters for discussion the meeting was adjourned at 7:55 p.m.
Approved as presented by the Council at their meeting held September 2, 2009.
Laura M. Nieto, CMC
Deputy City Clerk
